data.long_meaning: Danilo is derived from the Hebrew name Daniel, which means 'God is my judge'. It is also related to the Greek name Dionysios, which means 'dedicated to Dionysus, the god of wine and festivity'. In the Bible, Daniel was a prophet who remained faithful to God during the Babylonian captivity, despite facing many trials and temptations. He is known for his wisdom and courage, and his name serves as a reminder of God's justice and faithfulness.
